articles.summary: Program advances Jackson’s growth and diversification strategy, increases access to annuities Jackson National Life Insurance Company ® (Jackson®), the main operating subsidiary of Jackson Financial Inc. i (NYSE: JXN), today announced a new annuity program – AARP® Annuity Program from Jackson, an exclusive offering created for AARP members. Through the program, AARP members will have access to a distinct set of Jackson annuities and educational resources designed to help support financial security and retirement confidence. The initial launch of the program is expected on November 16, 2026, in 10 states, with broader availability targeted during the first half of 2027. The program advances Jackson’s growth and diversification strategy and expands consumer access to annuities. “This program reflects Jackson’s continued focus on growth, diversification and meeting consumers where they are in their retirement planning process,” said Alison Reed, EVP, Head of Distribution, Jackson
articles.title: Jackson Announces New Annuity Offering for AARP Members

articles.summary: Jackson Financial Inc. 1 (Jackson®) announced its Board of Directors has declared a cash dividend of $0.90 per share of common stock (NYSE: JXN) for the fourth quarter of 2026. The dividend on the common stock will be payable on December 17, 2026, to shareholders of record at the close of business on December 3, 2026. The Company also announced the declaration of a cash dividend of $0.50 per depositary share (NYSE: JXN PR A), each representing a 1/1,000th interest in a share of Fixed-Rate Reset Noncumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock, Series A. The dividend will be payable on December 30, 2026, to shareholders of record at the close of business on December 3, 2026. In addition, Jackson’s Board has authorized an increase of $1 billion to the Company’s existing common share repurchase authorization, which adds to the remaining authorization of approximately $353 million as of September 30, 2026. articles.summary: More than one-third of pre-retirees give significant support to adult family members, with Gen-X carrying the heaviest load Investors financially supporting family are depleting savings and falling further behind on retirement planning Nearly 70% of financial professionals do not consider financial support for family as a significant risk Jackson National Life Insurance Company® (Jackson®), the main operating subsidiary of Jackson Financial Inc. i (NYSE: JXN), today released new research showing that helping family members financially has become a routine, recurring expense of many Americans nearing retirement, and one that can quietly erode their own financial security. articles.summary: Four distinct Jackson products now available to AARP members in 10 states Jackson National Life Insurance Company ® (Jackson®), the main operating subsidiary of Jackson Financial Inc. 1 (NYSE: JXN), today announced the official launch of its annuity program – AARP® Annuity Program from Jackson, an exclusive offering created for AARP members. A distinct set of Jackson products designed specifically for the direct-to-consumer market are now available exclusively to AARP members in 10 states: Arizona, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Indiana, Louisiana, Michigan, Ohio, Pennsylvania and South Dakota.
